name: Contract Publishers / Content Production for Clients

pain_points: Deliver into the void - cannot see performance data
No visibility once content delivered to client systems

fit_logic.proceed: Contract publisher can control or co-own deployment environment (even partially)
fit_logic.park: They want proof but have no access to analytics or distribution control
fit_logic.stop: They are purely production with no appetite for platform layer

what_they_sell: Output volume, quality, compliance handling, reliability
what_proof_means: Proof to the client that the content performed (so they retain the account). Internal proof to reduce rework and firefighting.
yoke_strengths: If they can attach Yoke as the measurement/proof layer and regain visibility
Speeds up reuse and reduces rebuild cycles across assets
yoke_weaknesses: If the client refuses external platforms or the agency cannot control deployment

messaging.value_proposition: Yoke helps contract publishers regain visibility and prove content performance—reducing rework and strengthening client retention.
key_benefits: Attach measurement layer to delivered content
messaging.elevator_pitch: Contract publishers deliver content then lose visibility. Yoke lets you attach a proof layer—showing clients what worked and strengthening retention.

unknowns: Typical procurement pattern: who signs off platform vs content

two_lever_framing.lever_a: Increase client retention with performance proof
